title: The Savior Calls; Let Every Ear
description: The Savior Calls; Let Every Ear in Tonic Solfa to WINCHESTER OLD, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: Anne Steele wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 47.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to WINCHESTER OLD; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: The Sa-vior calls; let ev-ery ear At-tend the heav-enly sound, Ye doubt-ing souls, dis-miss your fear; Hope smiles re-viv-ing round.

lines: The Savior calls; let every ear
Ye doubting souls, dismiss your fear;
And life and health and bliss impart
Here springs of sacred pleasures rise
Nor shall you thirst in vain.
And take the bliss Thy love imparts

licence: Public domain: Anne Steele died in 1778.
credits: Words by Anne Steele (1717–1778), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to WINCHESTER OLD by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
